note: Shared work-level glossary for the Iliad (Monro & Allen, Oxford 1920). Keys are lowercased surface wordforms as printed (an elided form without its apostrophe). One general gloss per form, never pinned to a line; sentence notes carry context.

glossary.αἰδεῖσθαί: αἰδέομαι — respect, stand in awe of, show regard for; pres. inf. mid. (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
glossary.αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.αὐτοῖσι: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’them themselves, them’
glossary.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
glossary.αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.αὐτῆμαρ: αὐτῆμαρ — on that very day; adv. (αὐτός + ἦμαρ)
glossary.αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
glossary.βάλλ: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βάλλ’ = βάλλε; Attic ἔβαλλε)
glossary.βέλεσσιν: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic βέλεσι)
glossary.βέλος: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.βασιλεὺς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. used as vocative in address: ’king!’
glossary.βασιλῆϊ: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic βασιλεῖ)
glossary.βιοῖο: βιός — bow; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ); a poetic word = τόξον, not βίος ’life’
glossary.βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
glossary.βούλεται: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’wants’
glossary.βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
glossary.γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
glossary.γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
glossary.γένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγένοντο)
glossary.γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.: ’old man!’
glossary.γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
glossary.γεραιὸς: γεραιός — old; as a noun, ’old man’; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
glossary.δέχεσθαι: δέχομαι — receive, accept; pres. inf. mid.; may stand for an imperative, ’accept’
glossary.δέχθαι: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. inf. mid., athematic epic form (= Attic δέξασθαι)
glossary.δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δαμᾷ: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower, lay low; fut. 3 sg., contracted (= δαμάσει); some take it as a present
glossary.δαναοὶ: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δαναοῖσιν: Δαναοί — the Danaans (a name for the Greeks); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δεινὴ: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg.; τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth (day)’
glossary.δερκομένοιο: δέρκομαι — see, look; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’seeing’
glossary.δηθύνοντ: δηθύνω — linger, tarry; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (δηθύνοντ’ = δηθύνοντα)
glossary.διαστήτην: διΐστημι — set apart; intrans. aor. ’stand apart, part’; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= διεστήτην)
glossary.διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
glossary.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis
glossary.διῒ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic Διΐ (= Διί); Διῒ φίλος ’dear to Zeus’
glossary.δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they should give’
glossary.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι)
glossary.δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
glossary.δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
glossary.δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
glossary.δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
glossary.δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
glossary.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
glossary.εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
glossary.εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.εἴπῃς: εἶπον — say, tell, name; aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.εἴτ: εἴτε — whether, either; conj., elided (εἴτ’ = εἴτε)
glossary.εὐχωλῆς: εὐχωλή — vow, prayer; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’
glossary.εὔχεται: εὔχομαι — claim, boast, profess; pres. 3 sg.: ’claims (to be)’ · also pray, + dat.: ’prays’ (Διὶ δ’ εὔχεται ’and to Zeus he prays’)
glossary.ζαθέην: ζάθεος — most holy, very sacred (intensive ζα- + θεός); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ζῶντος: ζάω — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
glossary.θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
glossary.θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’
glossary.θάρσησε: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάρσησε)
glossary.θαμειαί: θαμέες (fem. θαμειαί) — close-set, crowded, thick; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.θαρσήσας: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken courage’
glossary.θεοπροπίας: θεοπροπία — prophecy, a god’s message; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.θεοπρόπιον: θεοπρόπιον — prophecy, oracle, a god’s message; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
glossary.θεοῖο: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) · also of a goddess, θεός being common in gender
glossary.θεστορίδης: Θεστορίδης — son of Thestor, patronymic of Calchas; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
glossary.θνήσκοντας: θνήσκω — die; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.θοὰς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας: ’swift (ships)’
glossary.θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
glossary.θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
glossary.θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
glossary.κάλχαν: Κάλχας — Calchas, seer of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.κάλχας: Κάλχας — Calchas, seer of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κέλεαί: κέλομαι — bid, urge, command; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εαι (= κέλῃ), accented before an enclitic
glossary.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
glossary.κήδετο: κήδω — trouble; mid. κήδομαι + gen. ’care for’; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκήδετο)
glossary.κίλλαν: Κίλλα — Cilla, a town of the Troad with a cult of Apollo; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καίοντο: καίω — burn; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐκαίοντο): ’were burning’
glossary.κακήν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
glossary.καλέσσατο: καλέω — call, summon; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic -σσ- (= ἐκαλέσατο)
glossary.καρήνων: κάρηνον — head, peak, summit; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.)
glossary.καταπέψῃ: καταπέσσω — digest, lit. ’cook down’; of anger, ’swallow, keep down’; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’)
glossary.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’)
glossary.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη)
glossary.κινηθέντος: κινέω — move, set in motion; aor. part. pass. masc. gen. sg.: ’as he moved’
glossary.κιχείω: κιχάνω — come upon, find, overtake; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic
glossary.κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.κλαγγὴ: κλαγγή — clamour, shrill cry, din; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κλῦθί: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear me!’
glossary.κνίσης: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — savour of burning fat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic κνίσης): ’of the fat’
glossary.κοίλῃσιν: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.κοσμήτορε: κοσμήτωρ — marshaller, commander (from κοσμέω ’set in order’); masc. acc. dual
glossary.κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρήηνον: κραιαίνω (= κραίνω) — accomplish, fulfil; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic
glossary.κρατέει: κρατέω — be strong; rule, + gen. ’over’; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= κρατεῖ)
glossary.κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κρείσσων: κρατύς — strong; comparative κρείσσων, stronger, mightier (= Attic κρείττων); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κότον: κότος — grudge, rancour, wrath; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κύνεσσιν: κύων — dog; dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic κυσί)
glossary.κῆλα: κῆλον — shaft, arrow (poetic, of a god’s missiles); neut. nom. pl.
glossary.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’
glossary.λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λίσσετο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, pray to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλίσσετο)
glossary.λαοί: λαός — people, host, the men of an army; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
glossary.λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
glossary.λητοῦς: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.λητώ: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; nom. sg.
glossary.λοιγὸν: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, havoc; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λοιμὸς: λοιμός — plague, pestilence; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λυσόμενός: λύω — loose, release; mid. ’ransom, get freed’; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to ransom’ (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.λύσαιτε: λύω — loose, release; aor. opt. 2 pl., in a polite request: ’would you release’
glossary.λύσω: λύω — loose, release, set free; fut. 1 sg. (same form as aor. subj.)
glossary.μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
glossary.μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
glossary.μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
glossary.μάντιν: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
glossary.μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
glossary.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
glossary.μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj.
glossary.μαντοσύνην: μαντοσύνη — the seer’s art, prophetic skill; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
glossary.μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
glossary.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
glossary.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
glossary.μηρί: μηρίον — thigh-piece, burned as an offering; neut. acc. pl., elided (μηρί’ = μηρία)
glossary.μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
glossary.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
glossary.μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.μυρί: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl., elided (μυρί’ = μυρία)
glossary.μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μὰ: μά — by (in oaths, + acc. of the one sworn by); particle: οὐ μά ‘no, by …’
glossary.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
glossary.μῆνιν: μῆνις — wrath, lasting anger (esp. a god’s); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
glossary.νέηαι: νέομαι — go home, return; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= νέῃ)
glossary.νήεσσ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., elided (νήεσσ’ = νήεσσι), epic (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νεκύων: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
glossary.νηυσί: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί), without ν-movable
glossary.νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νηὸν: ναός (epic νηός) — temple, shrine; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ναόν)
glossary.νοῦσον: νοῦσος — sickness, disease; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic νόσος)
glossary.νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
glossary.νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.ξυνέηκε: συνίημι — bring together, set together; aor. 3 sg., old spelling ξυν- (= συν-), epic -έηκε (= συνῆκε) · also συνίημι — perceive, understand; aor. 3 sg. (ξυνέηκε θεᾶς ὄπα ’understood the voice of the goddess’)
glossary.οἰωνοπόλων: οἰωνοπόλος — bird-diviner, one who reads omens from birds; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.οἰωνοῖσί: οἰωνός — bird of prey; bird of omen; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
glossary.οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
glossary.οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
glossary.οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
glossary.οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
glossary.οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
glossary.οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
glossary.οὐλομένην: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. οὐλόμενος used as adj., ’accursed, ruinous’; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
glossary.οὐρῆας: οὐρεύς — mule; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ὀρεῖς)
glossary.οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
glossary.οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a messenger is to tell (= ὅτι): ἐρέοντα … οὕνεκα ’to tell that’
glossary.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
glossary.πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
glossary.πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παλιμπλαγχθέντας: παλιμπλάζομαι — be driven back off course (πάλιν + πλάζω); aor. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’)
glossary.παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πείθονται: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’obey’
glossary.πεπίθοιμεν: πείθω — persuade, win over; reduplicated aor. opt. 1 pl., epic
glossary.περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
glossary.πηληϊάδεω: Πηληϊάδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’
glossary.πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
glossary.πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’
glossary.πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
glossary.πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’
glossary.πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προΐαψεν: προϊάπτω — send forth, hurl (down to Hades); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
glossary.πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
glossary.πυραὶ: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
glossary.πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
glossary.πόλεμός: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg. (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
glossary.πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.σαώσεις: σαόω — save, keep safe (epic = σῴζω); fut. 2 sg.
glossary.σαώτερος: σάος — safe (epic = σῶς); comparative, masc. nom. sg.: ’safer’
glossary.σκήπτρῳ: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σμινθεῦ: Σμινθεύς — Smintheus, a cult title of Apollo, of uncertain meaning; voc. sg.
glossary.σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
glossary.σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.στέμμα: στέμμα — fillet, the woollen band of a god, carried by his priest; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.στέμματ: στέμμα — fillet, the woollen band of a god; neut. acc. pl., elided (στέμματ’ = στέμματα)
glossary.στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
glossary.στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.συμπάντων: σύμπας — all together, the whole; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
glossary.σφωε: σφωέ — they two, the two of them; epic dual pron., acc. (= Attic αὐτώ)
glossary.σύνθεο: συντίθημι — put together; mid. take to heart, mark; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic σύνθου)
glossary.σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’
glossary.τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’)
glossary.τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
glossary.τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic
glossary.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τίσειαν: τίνω — pay, pay a price for; aor. opt. 3 pl., of wish: ’may they pay for’
glossary.τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
glossary.τελέσσῃ: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσῃ)
glossary.τελείων: τέλειος — full-grown, perfect (of sacrificial victims); gen. pl.
glossary.τενέδοιό: Τένεδος — Tenedos, an island off the Troad; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (accented before an enclitic)
glossary.τεῦχε: τεύχω — make, prepare, build; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευχε)
glossary.τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’)
glossary.τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
glossary.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
glossary.τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
glossary.τοὔνεκ: τοὔνεκα — for that reason, on that account (τοῦ ἕνεκα); adv., elided (τοὔνεκ’)
glossary.τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’
glossary.τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
glossary.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
glossary.τόξ: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. pl. (the plural often of a single bow), elided (τόξ’ = τόξα)
glossary.τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’
glossary.τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
glossary.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’
glossary.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
glossary.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει)
glossary.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
glossary.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’
glossary.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’)
glossary.φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
glossary.φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φαρέτρην: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α; Attic φαρέτρᾱν)
glossary.φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φράσαι: φράζομαι — consider, think out, take thought; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’consider’ · also aor. imper. mid. with the eyes: ’observe, take note of’ (οὐλὴν … φράσαι ὀφθαλμοῖσι ’observe this scar with your eyes’)
glossary.φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
glossary.φύγοιμεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 1 pl.: ’we might escape’
glossary.χέρηϊ: χέρης — lesser, inferior, weaker; masc. dat. sg., epic
glossary.χαρίεντ: χαρίεις — graceful, pleasing; masc. acc. sg., elided (χαρίεντ’ = χαρίεντα)
glossary.χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χολωθεὶς: χολόω — anger; pass. ’be angered’ (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χολωσέμεν: χολόω — anger, make angry; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= χολώσειν)
glossary.χραίσμῃ: χραισμέω — help, avail, ward off; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.χρυσέῳ: χρύσεος — golden; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῷ)
glossary.χρύσην: Χρύσης — Chryses, priest of Apollo; masc. acc. sg. · also Χρύση — Chryse, his town in the Troad; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χωομένοιο: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο
glossary.χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
glossary.χώσεται: χώομαι — be incensed, be angry; aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel (= χώσηται)
glossary.ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαμέμνονα: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
glossary.ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
glossary.ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
glossary.ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
glossary.ἀμφηρεφέα: ἀμφηρεφής — covered at both ends, close-lidded (of a quiver); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιβέβηκας: ἀμφιβαίνω — stand astride, stand over to protect; perf. 2 sg., with present sense
glossary.ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act.; ἀπὸ … ἀμῦναι ’ward off from’
glossary.ἀνάποινον: ἀνάποινος — without ransom; fem. acc. sg. (two-termination adjective)
glossary.ἀνάσσεις: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. · also + dat., ’rule over’ (θεοῖσι καὶ ἀνθρώποισιν ἀνάσσεις)
glossary.ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
glossary.ἀναφαίνεις: ἀναφαίνω — show forth, reveal, declare; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀνιστάμενος: ἀνίστημι — raise up; mid. ’stand up, rise’; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντιάσας: ἀντιάω — meet, partake of, + gen.; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀντιόωσαν: ἀντιάω — meet, partake of, share; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic diectasis (= ἀντιῶσαν)
glossary.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
glossary.ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
glossary.ἀπέλυσε: ἀπολύω — set free, release; aor. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
glossary.ἀπεδέξατ: ἀποδέχομαι — accept, receive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἀπεδέξατ’ = ἀπεδέξατο)
glossary.ἀπερείσι: ἀπερείσιος — boundless, unstinted; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀπερείσι’ = ἀπερείσια)
glossary.ἀπονοστήσειν: ἀπονοστέω — return home, come back; fut. inf. act.
glossary.ἀπριάτην: ἀπρίατος — unbought, not paid for; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπώσει: ἀπωθέω — thrust away, push back; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
glossary.ἀρήξειν: ἀρήγω — help, aid, + dat.; fut. inf.
glossary.ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀργούς: ἀργός — swift, or white, gleaming (the sense is disputed); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
glossary.ἀργυρότοξ: ἀργυρότοξος — silver-bowed, epithet of Apollo; voc. sg., elided (ἀργυρότοξ’ = ἀργυρότοξε)
glossary.ἀρητῆρα: ἀρητήρ — one who prays, priest (from ἀράομαι ’pray’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρητῆρος: ἀρητήρ — one who prays, priest (from ἀράομαι ’pray’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀρνῶν: ἀρήν — lamb; gen. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδα: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. acc. dual: ’the two sons of Atreus’
glossary.ἀτρεΐδαι: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc./nom. pl.: ’sons of Atreus’
glossary.ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀφίει: ἀφίημι — let go, let fly; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἠφίει)
glossary.ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιοῖς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
glossary.ἀχιλεῦ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. voc. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῦ)
glossary.ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
glossary.ἁζόμενοι: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, revere; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’out of awe’
glossary.ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
glossary.ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
glossary.ἄειδε: ἀείδω — sing; pres. imper. 2 sg. · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
glossary.ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
glossary.ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
glossary.ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
glossary.ἄργεϊ: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄϊδι: Ἅιδης (epic also Ἄϊς) — Hades, god of the dead; dat. sg. of Ἄϊς
glossary.ἐέλδωρ: ἐέλδωρ — wish, desire; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
glossary.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
glossary.ἐκπέρσαι: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. inf.
glossary.ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
glossary.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
glossary.ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
glossary.ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
glossary.ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
glossary.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
glossary.ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
glossary.ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
glossary.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’)
glossary.ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. ’obey’, + dat.; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’obeyed’
glossary.ἐπευφήμησαν: ἐπευφημέω — shout assent, approve aloud; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπιμέμφεται: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault, + gen. of the cause; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐποίσει: ἐπιφέρω — bring upon, lay on; fut. 3 sg.; χεῖρας ἐποίσει ’will lay hands on’
glossary.ἐποιχομένην: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at; of the loom, ’ply’; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’)
glossary.ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro, go round to; go at, attack; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐρέθιζε: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, irritate; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
glossary.ἐρίσαντε: ἐρίζω — quarrel, strive; aor. part. masc. nom. dual
glossary.ἐρείομεν: ἐρέω (epic) — ask, enquire; subj. 1 pl., short vowel, hortatory: ’let us ask’
glossary.ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
glossary.ἐσσόμενα: εἰμί — be; fut. part. neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -σσ- (= ἐσόμενα): ’things to come’
glossary.ἐτελείετο: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; impf. pass. 3 sg., epic -είετο (= Attic ἐτελεῖτο): ’was being fulfilled’
glossary.ἐφιεὶς: ἐφίημι — send at, let fly at, + dat.; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐχεπευκὲς: ἐχεπευκής — sharp-pointed (the usual explanation; formation uncertain); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐχώσατο: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
glossary.ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
glossary.ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
glossary.ἑκατηβελέταο: ἑκατηβελέτης — far-darting, epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑκατόμβης: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, large sacrifice (lit. of a hundred oxen); gen. sg.
glossary.ἑκηβόλον: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting (the usual explanation), epithet of Apollo; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑκηβόλος: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting, epithet of Apollo, also standing alone for the god; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκηβόλου: ἑκηβόλος — far-shooting, epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑλικώπιδα: ἑλικῶπις — quick-eyed (sense disputed: ’lively-eyed’ or ’dark-eyed’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλώρια: ἑλώριον — prey, spoil (from ἑλεῖν ’take’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑοῖσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; Homeric ἑός, = Attic ἑαυτοῦ, ἴδιος) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις); not the relative
glossary.ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
glossary.ἔκηα: καίω — burn; aor. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἔκαυσα); with κατά in tmesis, ’burned up’
glossary.ἔκλαγξαν: κλάζω — ring, clang, scream; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
glossary.ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
glossary.ἔπεισιν: ἔπειμι (εἶμι + ἐπί) — come upon, come on; pres. 3 sg. with future sense: ’will come upon’
glossary.ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
glossary.ἔπεσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι), ν-movable: ’with words’
glossary.ἔριδι: ἔρις — strife, quarrel; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἔτελλε: τέλλω — with ἐπί (ἐπιτέλλω), ’enjoin, lay a charge on’; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
glossary.ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
glossary.ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
glossary.ἕηκε: ἵημι — send, let fly; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= ἧκε)
glossary.ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
glossary.ἠΰκομος: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, epithet of goddesses and women; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἠρᾶθ: ἀράομαι — pray; impf. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἠρᾶθ’ = ἠρᾶτο)
glossary.ἠτίμησ: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἠτίμησ’ = ἠτίμησε)
glossary.ἡγήσατ: ἡγέομαι — lead, guide, + dat.; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἡγήσατ’ = ἡγήσατο)
glossary.ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
glossary.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative
glossary.ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
glossary.ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
glossary.ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
glossary.ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
glossary.ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
glossary.ἤϊε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει)
glossary.ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to, + dat.; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s lost digamma)
glossary.ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
glossary.ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα
glossary.ἰφθίμους: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
glossary.ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
glossary.ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
glossary.ἱερῆα: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic ἱερέα)
glossary.ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
glossary.ἱλασσάμενοι: ἱλάσκομαι — propitiate, appease; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic -σσ-
glossary.ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
glossary.ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
glossary.ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
glossary.ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
glossary.ὀλέκοντο: ὀλέκω — destroy; mid./pass. ’perish’; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ὀλύμπια: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ὀνειροπόλον: ὀνειροπόλος — interpreter of dreams; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
glossary.ὁρᾶτο: ὁράω — see; impf. 3 sg. mid., with active sense: ’saw’
glossary.ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’)
glossary.ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
glossary.ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
glossary.ὄμοσσον: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic -σσ-
glossary.ὄναρ: ὄναρ — dream, vision seen in sleep (opposed to ὕπαρ); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρσε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὦρσε)
glossary.ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
glossary.ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
glossary.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν)
glossary.ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
glossary.ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
glossary.ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
glossary.ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
glossary.ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
glossary.ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’)
glossary.ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
glossary.ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
glossary.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
glossary.ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
glossary.αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰχμητάων: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.αἴαντος: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἴτιοί: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl. (accented before the enclitic that follows)
glossary.αὐτίχ: αὐτίκα — at once, straightaway; adv., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (αὐτίχ’ = αὐτίκα)
glossary.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’, or intensive ’her herself’
glossary.αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
glossary.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’
glossary.αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
glossary.βήσομεν: βαίνω — go; aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= βήσωμεν), causative: ’let us put aboard’
glossary.βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
glossary.βουληφόρος: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, giving counsel; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βούλομ: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (βούλομ’ = βούλομαι): ’I prefer’ (with ἤ ’rather than’)
glossary.βούλομαι: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 1 sg. mid., + inf.: ’I prefer, I want’
glossary.βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; fem. acc. pl. ’cattle’ · also nom. sg. (same spelling): ’the ox, the heifer’
glossary.βρισηΐδα: Βρισηΐς — Briseis, the captive woman of Achilles; fem. acc. sg. (-ηΐδα)
glossary.βωτιανείρῃ: βωτιάνειρα — man-nourishing, nurse of men; fem. dat. sg., epithet of Phthia
glossary.γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.δέδασται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been divided’
glossary.δέμας: δέμας — bodily frame, build; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in build’
glossary.δέξασθαι: δέχομαι — receive, accept; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.δασμὸς: δασμός — division, sharing out (of spoil); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεινὼ: δεινός — dread, terrible; dual nom./acc., agreeing with ὄσσε ’two eyes’
glossary.δευόμενον: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’lacking’
glossary.δεῦρο: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv.
glossary.διάνδιχα: διάνδιχα — in two ways, divided; adv. (δι- + ἀνδίχα)
glossary.διέπουσ: διέπω — manage, carry through, dispatch; pres. 3 pl., elided (διέπουσ’ = διέπουσι)
glossary.διοτρεφέων: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured; masc. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
glossary.δώωσιν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 pl., epic (= Attic δῶσι)
glossary.δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the divine brine’)
glossary.δῷσι: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may grant’
glossary.εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
glossary.εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
glossary.εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
glossary.εἵνεκ: εἵνεκα (elided εἵνεκ’) — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἕνεκα)
glossary.εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
glossary.εἶπας: εἶπον — say; aor. 2 sg. with the first-aorist ending -ας (= Attic εἶπες): ’you said’
glossary.εἷς: εἷς — one; numeral, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
glossary.εὐτείχεον: εὐτείχης — well-walled; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐτειχῆ)
glossary.ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
glossary.θάλασσά: θάλασσα — sea; fem. nom. sg. (accented before the enclitic that follows)
glossary.θάμβησεν: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάμβησεν)
glossary.θείομεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic (= Attic θῶμεν): ’let us put’
glossary.θεοείκελ: θεοείκελος — god-like, resembling the gods; masc. voc. sg., elided (θεοείκελ’ = θεοείκελε)
glossary.θεοπροπέων: θεοπροπέω — prophesy, utter oracles; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= θεοπροπῶν)
glossary.θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
glossary.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg.
glossary.θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
glossary.θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
glossary.κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc./nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom./voc. pl. in abuse, with ἐλέγχεα: ’base disgraces’
glossary.κάλχαντα: Κάλχας — Calchas, the Greek seer; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάμω: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; aor. subj. 1 sg., short vowel: ’I grow weary’
glossary.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’
glossary.κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic κέλῃ)
glossary.κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
glossary.καλλιπάρῃον: καλλιπάρῃος — fair-cheeked; fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic καλλιπάρειος)
glossary.καρπὸν: καρπός — fruit, crop, harvest; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.καρτερός: καρτερός — strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg., epic (= κρατερός)
glossary.κείμενα: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up; pres. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’lying (there)’
glossary.κερδαλεόφρον: κερδαλεόφρων — gain-minded, crafty in profit; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.κεχολώσεται: χολόω — anger; mid. χολόομαι ’be angry’; fut. perf. 3 sg. mid.: ’will be angry’
glossary.κηδομένη: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg. · also be troubled, distressed (κηδομένη περ ’worried though you are’)
glossary.κλέπτε: κλέπτω — steal, cheat, deceive; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’deceive!’
glossary.κλισίην: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. acc. sg. (Attic κλισία)
glossary.κλυταιμνήστρης: Κλυταιμνήστρη — Clytemnestra, wife of Agamemnon; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κολεοῖο: κολεός — sheath, scabbard; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κορωνίσιν: κορωνίς — curved, with a curved stern (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισιν, agreeing with νηυσί
glossary.κοτέοντος: κοτέω — be angry, bear a grudge; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., uncontracted (= κοτοῦντος)
glossary.κουριδίης: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
glossary.κούρης: κούρη — girl, maiden (Attic κόρη); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κρήγυον: κρήγυος — true, good, welcome; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
glossary.κυνῶπα: κυνώπης — dog-eyed, shameless one; masc. voc. sg. (a term of abuse)
glossary.κύδιστε: κύδιστος — most glorious, greatest; masc. voc. sg., superlative, address
glossary.λίσσομαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc. of the person (and inf.): ’I beg you to…’
glossary.λαμπετόωντι: λαμπετάω — blaze, gleam, flash (extended epic form of λάμπω); pres. part. neut. dat. sg., uncontracted: ’blazing’
glossary.λαοὺς: λαός — people, folk, host; masc. acc. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς)
glossary.λασίοισι: λάσιος — hairy, shaggy; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λεύσσετε: λεύσσω — see, look at; pres. 2 pl. indic.: ’you see’
glossary.μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
glossary.μάντι: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.μάχαι: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’
glossary.μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
glossary.μένεος: μένος — might, fury, passion; neut. gen. sg., genitive of material or cause: ’with fury’
glossary.μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.μαχησόμενος: μάχομαι — fight; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -ησ- (= Attic μαχεσόμενος), of purpose: ’to fight’
glossary.μεγάθυμοι: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.μενελάῳ: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, brother of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μερμήριξεν: μερμηρίζω — ponder, waver, be in doubt; aor. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
glossary.μετατρέπῃ: μετατρέπομαι — turn oneself to, pay heed to (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic -ῃ (= -εαι): ’you pay regard’
glossary.μεταφρασόμεσθα: μεταφράζομαι — consider afterwards, reconsider; fut. 1 pl. mid., epic -σθα (= -σόμεθα): ’we shall consider later’
glossary.μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
glossary.μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
glossary.μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
glossary.μυρμιδόνεσσιν: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
glossary.μόγησα: μογέω — toil, labour, suffer hardship; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I toiled’
glossary.μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’
glossary.ναιόμενον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. pass. neut. acc. sg.: ’well-inhabited’
glossary.νηΐ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables), of means: ’by ship’
glossary.νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
glossary.νῆα: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg., epic νῆα
glossary.ξανθῆς: ξανθός — yellow, fair (of hair); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ξυνήϊα: ξυνήϊος — common, shared (= Attic κοινός); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’common goods’
glossary.οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
glossary.οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; masc. dat. sg.: ’to him alone’
glossary.οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
glossary.οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
glossary.οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
glossary.οὔρεά: ὄρος — mountain; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic οὔρεα (= Attic ὄρη)
glossary.οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
glossary.οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
glossary.οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
glossary.πάρ: παρά — beside, with; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά) · also πάρα (elided πάρ’) = πάρεισι: ’there are at hand’
glossary.πίμπλαντ: πίμπλημι — fill; impf. pass. 3 pl., elided (πίμπλαντ’ = πίμπλαντο): ’were filling, were being filled’
glossary.παλίλλογα: παλίλλογος — gathered again, collected back; neut. nom./acc. pl., used adverbially: ’over again’
glossary.παλλάδ: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena; fem. acc. sg., elided (Παλλάδ’ = Παλλάδα)
glossary.παρελεύσεαι: παρέρχομαι — pass by, get past, outwit; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic παρελεύσῃ)
glossary.παύσειεν: παύω — stop, make cease; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’he should stop’
glossary.πείθηται: πείθομαι — obey, heed; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a deliberative question: ’is to obey’
glossary.πείσεις: πείθω — persuade, win over; fut. 2 sg.
glossary.πηλεΐδη: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. voc. sg., patronymic
glossary.πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
glossary.πηλεΐωνι: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom./acc. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’the greater part’
glossary.πλοῦτον: πλοῦτος — wealth, riches; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles
glossary.ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
glossary.πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πολίων: πόλις — city; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεων)
glossary.πολεμίζων: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
glossary.πολυάϊκος: πολυάϊξ — of much rushing, rushing violently (epithet of war); gen. sg., epic; the sense is uncertain
glossary.πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
glossary.ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
glossary.ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
glossary.που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
glossary.προβέβουλα: προβούλομαι — prefer; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I prefer’ (+ gen. of the person or thing rated lower)
glossary.προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
glossary.προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.πρόες: προΐημι — send forth, give up; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’give up!’
glossary.πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
glossary.πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen.
glossary.πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’)
glossary.πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
glossary.πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
glossary.πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
glossary.πόλεμοί: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. pl. (accented before the enclitic that follows)
glossary.πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
glossary.πώποτ: πώποτε — ever yet, at any time; adv., elided (πώποτ’ = πώποτε), with a negative: ’never yet’
glossary.σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
glossary.σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, shady; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.σοῖς: σός — your, yours; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.στυγέῃ: στυγέω — hate, shrink from; pres. subj. 3 sg., uncontracted (= στυγῇ): ’let him shrink from’
glossary.στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
glossary.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
glossary.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
glossary.σῇς: σός — your, yours (sg.); fem. dat. pl., agreeing with νηυσί
glossary.σῶν: σῶς (σάος, σόος) — safe, sound; masc. acc. sg., contracted (σῶν = σόον): ’safe’
glossary.τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
glossary.τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg.
glossary.τήνδ: ὅδε — this (one); fem. acc. sg., elided (τήνδ’ = τήνδε): ’this’
glossary.τήνδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (one); demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
glossary.τίπτ: τίπτε (= τί ποτε) — why ever, why then; interrog. adv., elided (τίπτ’ = τίπτε)
glossary.ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
glossary.ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
glossary.ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
glossary.τελέεσθαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. inf. pass./mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖσθαι): ’to be fulfilled’
glossary.τετραπλῇ: τετραπλόος — fourfold; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’fourfold’
glossary.τεύχει: τεύχω — make, fashion, cause; pres. 3 sg.: ’brings about’
glossary.τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος
glossary.τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, esteem; fem. acc. sg. · also requital, satisfaction for a wrong: ’redress’
glossary.τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
glossary.τοῦδ: ὅδε — this (one); demonstrative pron., neut. gen. sg., elided (τοῦδ’ = τοῦδε), with ἕνεκα: ’for this’
glossary.τριπλῇ: τριπλόος — threefold; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’threefold’
glossary.τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
glossary.τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’
glossary.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
glossary.υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
glossary.φάανθεν: φαίνω — show; pass. appear, shine; aor. 3 pl. pass., epic (φάανθεν = ἐφάνθησαν): ’shone, appeared’
glossary.φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
glossary.φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
glossary.φέρτερόν: φέρτερος — better, stronger; comparative (suppletive to ἀγαθός); neut. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.φέρτερός: φέρτερος — stronger, better; masc. nom. sg., predicate, accented before the enclitic εἰμί
glossary.φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’)
glossary.φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φαινομένη: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’appearing’
glossary.φεῦγε: φεύγω — flee, escape; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’flee!’
glossary.φθίην: Φθίη — Phthia, Achilles’ homeland in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg., with -δε ’to Phthia’
glossary.φθίῃ: Φθίη — Phthia, Achilles’ homeland in Thessaly; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φιλέουσά: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., uncontracted (= φιλοῦσα)
glossary.φιλοκτεανώτατε: φιλοκτέανος — loving possessions, greedy for gain; superl. φιλοκτεανώτατος, masc. voc. sg.
glossary.φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.φυήν: φυή — stature, natural growth, form; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
glossary.χαίρῃς: χαίρω — rejoice, take delight; pres. subj. 2 sg.: ’you may delight’
glossary.χερείων: χερείων — worse, inferior; epic comparative of κακός (= Attic χείρων); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χρυσηΐδα: Χρυσηΐς — Chryseis, daughter of Chryses; fem. acc. sg. (-ηΐδα)
glossary.χρυσηΐδος: Χρυσηΐς — Chryseis, daughter of Chryses; fem. gen. sg. (-ηΐδος)
glossary.ἀγέραστος: ἀγέραστος — without a prize of honour; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθός: ἀγαθός — good, brave; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγείρομεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ἀγείρωμεν): ’let us gather’
glossary.ἀγλά: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀγλά’ = ἀγλαά)
glossary.ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
glossary.ἀλεγίζεις: ἀλεγίζω — pay heed to, care for; pres. 2 sg., usually with a negative
glossary.ἀλεγίζω: ἀλεγίζω — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., usually with a negative
glossary.ἀμφιμέλαιναι: ἀμφιμέλας — black all about, black on both sides; fem. nom. pl., epithet of φρένες
glossary.ἀναιδείην: ἀναιδείη — shamelessness; fem. acc. sg. (Attic ἀναίδεια)
glossary.ἀναστήσειεν: ἀνίστημι — make stand up, raise; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’he should make (them) stand up’
glossary.ἀντάξιον: ἀντάξιος — worth as much, equivalent; neut. nom. sg.: ’of equal worth’
glossary.ἀπειλήσω: ἀπειλέω — threaten; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will threaten’
glossary.ἀπειλεῖς: ἀπειλέω — threaten; pres. 2 sg., + fut. inf.: ’you threaten to…’
glossary.ἀποδοῦναι: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, give up; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι ’perish’; aor. mid. inf.: ’to perish’
glossary.ἀποτείσομεν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, repay; fut. 1 pl., epic -τείσ- (= Attic ἀποτίσομεν)
glossary.ἀρνύμενοι: ἄρνυμαι — win, earn, gain; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’winning’
glossary.ἀρχὸς: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀτρεΐδην: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon (patronymic); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἀφαιρήσεσθαι: ἀφαιρέω — take away; mid. take away for oneself; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.ἀφαιρεῖται: ἀφαιρέω — take away; mid. take away for oneself, snatch; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἀφύξειν: ἀφύσσω — draw off, heap up; fut. inf.: ’to heap up’
glossary.ἀχιλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. nom. sg., single-λ metrical variant
glossary.ἀχνύμενος: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’)
glossary.ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
glossary.ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, take; pres. subj. 1 sg., short vowel, with κε (future-like): ’I shall lead’
glossary.ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
glossary.ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
glossary.ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
glossary.ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
glossary.ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν)
glossary.ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’rule!’
glossary.ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
glossary.ἄξω: ἄγω — lead, take; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will take’
glossary.ἄρσαντες: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, suit; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having suited, fitting (to the heart)’
glossary.ἄτιμος: ἄτιμος — unhonoured, without honour; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄφενος: ἄφενος — wealth, abundance; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
glossary.ἐΐκτην: ἔοικα — be like, seem; plpf. 3 dual, epic (= Attic ᾑκέτην), + dat.: ’the two were like’
glossary.ἐδηλήσαντ: δηλέομαι — harm, hurt, injure; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐδηλήσαντ’ = ἐδηλήσαντο)
glossary.ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλω: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐκπέρσωσ: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. subj. 3 pl., elided (ἐκπέρσωσ’ = ἐκπέρσωσι), after ὁππότε: ’whenever they sack’
glossary.ἐκπαγλότατ: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, overwhelming; superl. ἐκπαγλότατος, masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐκπαγλότατ’ = ἐκπαγλότατε)
glossary.ἐλθέμεναι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. inf. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come, to go’
glossary.ἐμαὶ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
glossary.ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἐμὰς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐναρίζοι: ἐναρίζω — kill and strip, slay; pres. opt. 3 sg. (in an indirect deliberative question): ’he should slay’
glossary.ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
glossary.ἐξαλαπάξαι: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, raze; aor. inf.
glossary.ἐξεπράθομεν: ἐκπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy; aor. 1 pl., epic stem πραθ- (= Attic ἐξεπέρσαμεν)
glossary.ἐπέοικε: ἐπέοικα (ἐπείκω) — be fitting, befit; perf. 3 sg., present sense, impersonal: ’it befits’
glossary.ἐπέσσυται: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, urge on; perf. pass. 3 sg., epic -σσ-: ’is driven on, is set upon’
glossary.ἐπαγείρειν: ἐπαγείρω — gather together, collect besides; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
glossary.ἐπιειμένε: ἐπιέννυμι — put on, clothe in (+ acc.); perf. part. mid./pass. masc. voc. sg.: ’clothed in’
glossary.ἐπιτηδὲς: ἐπιτηδές — on purpose, in earnest, suitably; adv. (Attic ἐπίτηδες)
glossary.ἐρέτας: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρητύσειέ: ἐρητύω — restrain, hold back; aor. opt. 3 sg. (accent thrown back before the enclitic τε): ’he should restrain’
glossary.ἐριβώλακι: ἐριβώλαξ — with rich soil, clod-rich; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having drawn (a sword)’
glossary.ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’
glossary.ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐτέλεσσας: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. 2 sg., epic -σσ-: ’you fulfilled’
glossary.ἐτράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐτράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned, changed’
glossary.ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
glossary.ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
glossary.ἑθέν: οὗ (ἕθεν) — of him, of her; epic 3rd-person reflexive/pron. gen. sg.: ’than her’ (gen. of comparison)
glossary.ἑκάεργον: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooting (epithet of Apollo); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking’
glossary.ἑσπόμεθ: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. 1 pl. mid., elided (ἑσπόμεθ’ = ἑσπόμεθα; Attic ἐσπόμεθα)
glossary.ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἑτοιμάσατ: ἑτοιμάζω — prepare, make ready; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἑτοιμάσατ’ = ἑτοιμάσατε)
glossary.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
glossary.ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
glossary.ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
glossary.ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
glossary.ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
glossary.ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
glossary.ἔμοιγε: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’to me, for my part’
glossary.ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
glossary.ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
glossary.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’)
glossary.ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρχομ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg., elided (ἔρχομ’ = ἔρχομαι)
glossary.ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
glossary.ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf.
glossary.ἔχθιστος: ἔχθιστος — most hateful; superl. of ἐχθρός, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔχῃς: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’you may have’
glossary.ἔω: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ὦ), in a purpose clause: ’I may be’
glossary.ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
glossary.ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
glossary.ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’
glossary.ἕνεκά: ἕνεκα — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., accented ἕνεκά after its noun or pronoun
glossary.ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
glossary.ἠχήεσσα: ἠχήεις — echoing, resounding; fem. nom. sg., epic -ήεσσα
glossary.ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ
glossary.ἤλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. 3 pl., epic
glossary.ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’
glossary.ἥμιν: ἐγώ — I; epic dat. pl. ἥμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to/for us’
glossary.ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
glossary.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’)
glossary.ἧος: ἧος — while, until; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως)
glossary.ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’
glossary.ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
glossary.ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’sacred rites, offerings’
glossary.ἱλάσσεαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ἱλάσῃ), after ὄφρα: ’you may appease’
glossary.ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
glossary.ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’
glossary.ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
glossary.ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
glossary.ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I come to’
glossary.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
glossary.ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’
glossary.ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
glossary.ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃ): ’he may lose’
glossary.ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’
glossary.ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, foresee, forebode; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμοιωθήμεναι: ὁμοιόω — make like, make equal; aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ὁμοιωθῆναι): ’to be made equal’
glossary.ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
glossary.ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
glossary.ὄθομαι: ὄθομαι — care for, heed (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., epic, used with a negative
glossary.ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
glossary.ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
glossary.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj.
glossary.ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
glossary.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’)
glossary.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
glossary.ὑπεροπλίῃσι: ὑπεροπλίη — arrogance, overbearing violence; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
glossary.ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’)
glossary.ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
glossary.ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
glossary.ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
glossary.ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
glossary.ᾗς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὑπεροπλίῃσι
glossary.ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’
glossary.αἰγεΐδην: Αἰγεΐδης — son of Aegeus (patronymic of Theseus); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰχμητὴν: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative (’made him a spearman’)
glossary.αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
glossary.αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, at once; adv., accented before the enclitic τοι
glossary.αὐδή: αὐδή — voice, speech; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves, of their own accord’
glossary.αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
glossary.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’)
glossary.αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, now in turn; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic μιν
